start.eyebrow: A friendly place to build websites
start.title: Your first website starts here.
start.subtitle: Pick a template, change some text, and watch the page update as you type. Everything you need is already on your computer.
start.noRecent: Folders you open will show up here.
start.recentHint: Projects stay where they are on your disk.
start.footerNote: Everything runs on your computer, even without internet.

blank.name: Blank page
blank.description: One HTML page and one stylesheet. The gentlest start.

business-card.name: Business card site
business-card.description: Three linked pages with shared styles and a portrait.

php-form.name: PHP contact form
php-form.description: A working form that shows what the visitor sent.

workspace.phpUnavailable: PHP is not available. Pages are served without PHP.
workspace.treeTruncated: Some files are hidden because this folder is very large.
workspace.openFileHint: Choose a file in the list to start editing.

editor.noFileHint: Pick a file on the left, or create one with the + button.
editor.binaryTitle: This is not a text file
editor.binaryHint: Images and other binary files open in the preview instead of the editor.
editor.fileDeleted: This file was deleted on disk.
editor.fileDeletedHint: Your unsaved edits are kept. Save the file to restore it, or close the tab to discard them.

tags.title: Insert HTML
tags.hint: Place the cursor, then pick a tag. Selected text gets wrapped.
tags.disabled: Tags work in HTML and PHP files.

hints.skeleton: A complete HTML page with head and body.
hints.div: A block that groups other elements.
hints.header: The top area of a page.
hints.main: The main content of the page.
hints.section: A themed block inside the page.
hints.footer: The bottom area of a page.
hints.a: A link to another page or site.
hints.comment: A note that the browser ignores.
hints.link-css: Connect a CSS file to the page.

form.skeletonHint: This replaces what is selected, or inserts a full page at the cursor.
form.notHtmlFile: Open an HTML or PHP file to insert tags.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.emptyHint: Open an HTML or PHP file and it will appear here.
preview.failed: The page could not be loaded.
preview.serverFailed: The preview server is not running.
preview.phpFallback: PHP was not found, so this is a static preview. PHP code will not run.

problems.title: Problems
problems.emptyHint: HTML and PHP are checked when you save.

explain.doctype-first: Start the page with <!doctype html> so the browser knows which standard to use.
explain.tag-pair:
A tag was opened but not closed. Every
,

and similar tag needs a closing tag.
explain.id-unique: Two elements share the same id. An id may only be used once per page.
explain.alt-require: Images need an alt text so screen readers can describe them.
explain.attr-value-double-quotes: Put attribute values in double quotes, for example src="photo.jpg".
explain.spec-char-escape: The characters < and > inside text must be written as < and >.
explain.tagname-lowercase: Write tag names in lower case.

problems.phpExplain: PHP stopped because of this line. Compare it with the working example in the template.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Menus, hints, and messages change immediately.
settings.wordWrapHint: Long lines continue on the next row instead of scrolling sideways.
settings.autoSaveHint: The file is written after you stop typing.
settings.phpMissing: PHP not found — static preview only

createProject.title: Create a project
createProject.description: Choose a template, give the project a name, and pick where it should live.
createProject.name: Project name
createProject.nameHint: Letters, numbers, spaces, and dashes work well. No slashes.

newFile.title: New file
newFile.name: File name
newFile.hint: Include the extension, for example about.html or style.css.

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.name: Folder name
newFolder.hint: A folder keeps related files together.

dialog.trimHint: Spaces at the beginning and end will be removed.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message: The item moves to the Recycle Bin, so you can still restore it later.

conflict.title: File changed on disk
conflict.message: {{name}} was changed outside WebYou while you had unsaved edits. Choose which version to keep.
conflict.queue_one: {{count}} more file has an unresolved conflict.

saveFailed.title: Some files could not be saved
saveFailed.message_one: {{count}} file is still unsaved. Closing now would discard its edits.
saveFailed.message_other: {{count}} files are still unsaved. Closing now would discard their edits.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Check that the file is not open in another program.
errors.fileDeleted: The file was deleted on disk.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Access was denied. Close the file in another program or check its permissions.
errors.FILE_BUSY: The file is in use by another program.
errors.READ_ONLY: The file is on a read-only disk or folder.
errors.DISK_FULL: There is not enough disk space.
errors.INVALID_NAME: Use a name without slashes or special characters.
errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Some information was missing. Please try again.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: A file or folder with that name already exists.
errors.PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: That project folder no longer exists.
errors.NOT_A_DIRECTORY: That location is not a folder.
errors.NOT_A_FILE: That item is not a file.
errors.PATH_OUTSIDE_PROJECT: That file is outside the project folder.
errors.PHP_NOT_FOUND: PHP was not found. The static preview still works.
errors.TEMPLATE_MISSING: The template files are missing. Reinstall WebYou.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large for the editor.
errors.FILE_CHANGED: This file changed on disk since you opened it.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_ROOT: The project folder itself cannot be changed.
errors.SERVER_FAILED: The preview server could not start.
errors.UNSAFE_URL: Only web links can be opened.
errors.preload: The app could not reach its internal bridge. Please restart WebYou.

toast.fileDeletedExternally: {{name}} was deleted on disk. Your unsaved edits are kept.
